metadata.method: Unchanged main town external adapter with factual receipt fixtures and per-seed actual main public-operation bottled profiles. All shipments to existing town-liquor, release before receipt,24 bottles per release. Finance,main shop unlocks and full careers are NOT simulated. Initial aged stock and later releases assume prior planned supply.
limits: This is a receipt-controlled component experiment, not30-year playable main careers.

A bulk48 uses4-cask steady-state occupancy with24month age and6month release spacing; other policies at most3 for72month age/24month release spacing. Prepared stock uses negative-month history outside observation.
External adapter intentionally produces no trade events/new stockists; inquiry/visit are reactions only.

Matched policies use identical receiptId by month, aligning deterministic chance draws; only flavor or delivery schedule/count changes. All policies deliver only to the same town-liquor destination. Specific customer conversion or diversified main-shop allocation is not modeled.
Map timings are factual unlock maximum, not duration or timing of actual UI modals.
Contact counts include repeated events; first-arrival is not settlement.
Unreached outcomes are null/right-censored at360months; medians of reached subset explicitly report n/censoring.
